let sortedList := l
  let rec search (lst : List Nat) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
    match lst with
    | [] => n
    | x :: xs =>
      let isEqual := x = n
      let isGreater := x > n
      let nextCand := n - 1
      if isEqual then
        search xs nextCand
      else if isGreater then
        n
      else
        search xs n
  let result := search sortedList 0
  result
